scope: Issue #215 installed compatibility matrix, including completed work and valid incomplete attempts; no release publication
limitations: The pinned pre-1.0 bootstrap and candidate have identical production package content. This validates the extended journey, not a future 1.x release or every pre-1.0 format.

Package metadata is 0.7.0; exact commits and wheel hashes identify the installed artifacts. The release work now targets v0.8.0, which remains pre-1.0; the actual immutable future v1.0.0 stable baseline remains unset.
The installations share Python and dependencies through system-site-packages but independently contain gwflow.
All actual jobs were confirmed terminal and baseline workers stopped before candidate workers started. Storage and workflows stayed in place except intentional negative-case edits.

The existing backend fixture replays observed terminal states by exact old Submission name because the local scheduler loses history and reuses numeric IDs on restart. New jobs execute on real local workers.
The operator-recovery case additionally simulates expired history; the consumer guard simulates a later active observation. Fixture-rejected admissions never reach workers.
There was no live upgrade, mixed-version worker execution, relocation, downgrade, or managed record conversion.
selection: Full command output and timestamps remain in the raw transcript. Each case preserves command arguments/exit codes and handoff/outcome observations. Before path normalization, per-file snapshots and accepted-submission lists are summarized by count and digest; exact-name history maps by state counts and digest.

path_placeholders.<REPO>: Absolute checkout root. Relative commands and evidence paths are relative to it; file://<REPO>/... preserves absolute pip artifact URLs.
path_placeholders.<SECOND_FS>: Temporary directory on the separate /dev/shm filesystem used by the copying case. Results and staging stayed at these same paths and device/inode identities across the installation switch. The fixture removed this directory after checking and recording its outputs.
